description: This file defines the LogWrapper class, which implements a logging node interface. It wraps Android's native Log utility to enable logging with the ability to chain multiple log nodes for flexible log handling.

classes.name: LogWrapper
classes.description: A helper class that wraps Android's native Log utility, implementing the LogNode interface, and supports chaining to subsequent log nodes.

methods.name: getNext
methods.description: Returns the next LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setNext
methods.description: Sets the next LogNode to receive log data.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Processes and outputs a log message using Android's Log system, and forwards it to the next node if configured.
